data.headline: Oil and Gas Development Company revives well in Sindh:
data.summary: The Oil and Gas Development Company Ltd (OGDCL) has announced the successful revival of Dars West-2 Well located in Tando Allah Yar district, Sindh.

data.headline: OGDC revives heavy oil well:
data.summary: The OGDC has successfully revived a heavy oil well in the Rajian Oil Field, Chakwal, increasing production from 1,500 to 2,500 BPD.

data.headline: Leakage in Uch gas line: OGDC, UPL lock horns over force majeure notice:
data.summary: OGDC and UPL have reportedly locked horns on the ‘disputed’ force majeure notice on gas supply, well-informed sources in OGDC told Business Recorder.

data.headline: OGDC launches oil and gas production in Sanghar:
data.summary: OGDC has officially commenced production from its exploratory well Baloch-2, located in the Sembar formation within the Sanghar district of Sindh.

data.headline: OGDC discovers new gas reserves in Khairpur:
data.summary: OGDC, Pakistan’s largest E&P company, has made a significant natural gas discovery at the Shahu-1 well, located in Khairpur, Sindh.

data.headline: OGDC, Chinese co sign MoU on shale, tight gas exploration:
data.summary: In a significant development, during the ongoing 8th Silk Road International Expo for investment and trade forum in Xian, Shaaxi province China, an MOU is signed between OGDC the flagship E&P company of Pakistan and CCDC, the major player in drilling and upstream Oil field services of People’s Republic of China.

data.headline: OGDC finds new gas reserves in Sanghar:
data.summary: OGDC announced a significant gas and condensate discovery at Baloch-2 well in the exploratory zone of Sembar Formation located in Sanghar district of Sindh.

data.headline: OGDC launches first-ever commercial tight gas project
data.summary: OGDC, Pakistan's state-owned oil and gas explorer, has pioneered the commercial production of tight gas with the successful launch of Pakistan's first-ever Tight Gas project.
